memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, make twenty frames and forty silver bases — two under each frame. Make six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle, and make two frames for the corners at the far end. At these two corners they must be double from the bottom all the way to the top, and fitted into a single ring; both shall be alike. So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases — two under each frame." - Exodus 26:20-25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God assigns frames to every side — twenty for the north, twenty for the south, six for the west, and two specially made for the corners. Those corner frames were different, doubled and fitted into a ring, shaped for the particular pressure of holding two walls together. God did not make every frame identical, because not every position needed the same thing.

That is a comforting thought. Some people in God's house occupy corner positions. They hold together things that would otherwise pull apart — a difficult family, a struggling church, a tense workplace. Corner work is demanding, and it requires being shaped differently from everyone else. If that is your position, God has not overlooked you; He has designed you for it.

Paul reminds us that God has arranged the parts of the body, every one of them, just as He wanted them to be (1 Cor 12:18). You were not placed randomly. Your temperament, your experiences, even the shaping that felt uncomfortable at the time may be exactly what your position requires. Do not envy someone else's simpler frame. God knows where He has put you and what it takes to stand there.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Am I envying someone else's position instead of embracing my own?
Where has God placed me that requires the particular shaping He has given me?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You placed each part exactly where You wanted it. Help me embrace the position You have given me and trust that You have shaped me for it. Amen.
